items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint file
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, screenshots of tables in Excel, or whiteboard photos in PowerPoint — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints
items.description: We are updating archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints to align with cloud workloads. This change improves consistency, reduces noise in event reporting, and enhances performance when processing archive files.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
items.description: Call history in the Teams Calls app is being upgraded to make it easier to find and act on past call activity. Missed calls and associated voicemails will be consolidated into a single call history entry, reducing clutter and simplifying follow-up. Call history will also expand from 100 records to up to 3,000 records or 6 months of history, whichever limit is reached first, giving users more context when they need it.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
items.description: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
items.description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
items.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention capabilities based on files Last Accessed in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Ability to apply Retention labels and policies to items on OneDrive and SharePoint based on when the items were last accessed by an user.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
items.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. Updated August 18, 2026: Rollout timing of this feature is now planned for end of August through early September. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds
items.description: GCC-H and DoD sovereign cloud customers will be able to use features in Excel run by Insights Services, including Analyze Data found on the Data tab.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
items.description: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
items.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
items.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
items.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

items.title: Planner: My Tasks redesign
items.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Topic Assignments Included in Comment Report Export
items.description: When exporting comments to spreadsheet from the Comments report, the topic(s) assigned to each comment will be included in the export.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
items.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
items.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GCC
items.description: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GGC provides Teams admins with insights into external collaboration patterns - covering teams, federated domains, channels, guests, and internal users - along with recommended actions to enhance security for external collaboration.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
items.description: Introducing Data lifecycle management capabilities for Microsoft Planner. Compliance admins can now create a retention policy to manage content located in Microsoft Planner such as tasks for plans associated with an Microsoft 365 Group.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
items.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

items.title: Data Loss Prevention- DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
items.description:
Copilot for Security in DLP can summarize DLP policies. This enhancement enables DLP admins to gain insights on coverage of policies viz. location, classifiers and notifications, and more.
DLP admins can get these insights on all the policies or on few selected policies. They will be able to use prompts to gain deeper level view of how a policy is configured for their digital landscape. This helps them align their data posture on a regular basis and make corrections to policy posture as needed.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.
